decisionRule: flag if lower endpoint of the existing conditional 95% group-bootstrap interval for M2 vs M1 gain is greater than zero
estimand: Expected out-of-group loss(self) minus loss(self+partner) for this fixed training procedure under each complete synthetic observation process, in squared natural-log duration units.
null: Independent generated caller processes have no partner information given complete self history. Empirical false-trigger rate calibrates the frozen heuristic under this generator; nominal bootstrap coverage is not assumed.
causalInterpretation: Common-driver predictive flags are not false positives for predictive information. Counting them as direct influence would be unsupported attribution. This study cannot distinguish such mechanisms from flags alone.
coverage: Not estimated; no known finite-training reference gain is supplied.
monteCarlo: Wilson 95% interval for flag proportions; across-seed mean and sample SD/sqrt(n) for gain. Variants share seeds and are paired; do not pool them as independent runs.

generator.noise: seeded xorshift32 symmetric uniform [-1,1); two caller innovations and one shared-driver innovation every cycle
